title: Forest Carbon Partnership Facility (FCPF)
definition: A global partnership of governments, businesses, civil society, and Indigenous Peoples focused on reducing emissions from deforestation and forest degradation (REDD+), forest carbon stock conservation, sustainable management of forests, and enhancement of forest carbon stocks.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for Environment & Ecology (GS-III). Frequently linked with UNFCCC, Climate Finance, and India's NDCs under the Paris Agreement.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Forest Carbon Partnership Facility.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
